subject: ela
intro: Fourth graders choose words and sentences for effect. They use precise words to convey ideas exactly, choose punctuation for effect, and know when to use formal English (school, reports) versus informal English (talking with friends). Precise, vivid words make writing clearer and more interesting.

items.prompt: Which is more precise: 'The man walked' or 'The man limped'?

steps: A precise word gives an exact picture.

items.prompt: Which is more FORMAL: 'Can I go?' or 'Yo, can I bounce?'

steps: Formal English is standard and polite.
'Can I go?' is the formal choice.

items.prompt: Replace the weak word with a precise one: 'The food was good.' Make 'good' stronger.

steps: A precise word for very good food is 'delicious.'

items.prompt: A precise word for 'walked slowly and tired'?
